page: Microsoft Azure M128dms_v2 is a memory-intensive virtual machine belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv2 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server features 128 dedicated vCPUs and a massive memory capacity of 3892.0 GB, yielding approximately 30.41 GB of RAM per core.
This server configuration includes 4194 GB of local SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of memory relative to compute resources, this server is designed for memory-intensive workloads. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise-scale databases, large-scale in-memory caching, and complex data analytics where massive datasets must reside entirely in system memory.
